items.title: S&P affirms Kuwait’s ‘AA-’ rating as wealth buffers offset war-driven GDP slump
items.summary: Investing.com -- S&P Global Ratings affirmed Kuwait’s ‘AA-/A-1+’ long- and short-term sovereign credit ratings on November 20, maintaining a stable outlook despite acute economic disruptions from the regional Middle East conflict. The rating agency noted that Kuwait’s massive sovereign wealth buffers, estimated to exceed 600% of gross domestic product in 2026, provide sufficient financial cushion to absorb near-term fiscal and trade shocks.

items.title: S&P upgrades Uzbekistan to ’BB+’ on fiscal reforms and stronger external buffers
items.summary: Investing.com -- S&P Global Ratings upgraded Uzbekistan’s long-term foreign- and local-currency sovereign credit ratings to 'BB+' from 'BB' on Friday, placing the Central Asian nation one notch below investment grade with a stable outlook. The agency cited strengthening economic policymaking, ongoing energy and state-owned enterprise (SOE) reforms, and an improved external liquidity position bolstered by elevated gold prices.

items.title: S&P upgrades Zambia to ’B-/B’ on strong copper prices and debt progress
items.summary: Investing.com -- S&P Global Ratings upgraded Zambia’s long- and short-term sovereign credit ratings to 'B-/B' from 'CCC+/C' on Friday, citing supportive copper prices, strong economic expansion, and ongoing progress in restructuring the nation's debt. The rating agency assigned a stable outlook, signaling confidence that the southern African copper producer will continue its gradual fiscal consolidation despite lingering structural vulnerabilities.
